extracted.intended_audience: organizations, nonprofits, and government agencies seeking distribution and promotion of public service advertising (PSAs)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service standards for creating, distributing, promoting, and evaluating public service advertising (PSA) campaigns across broadcast, outdoor, digital and other media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy & Media
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with our clients to think through the details of distribution timing, media mix and audience segmentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan distribution timing, choose an appropriate media mix, and segment audiences deliberately to maximize PSA reach and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes media outreach, development of collateral and tactical placement of campaign assets on platforms where media outlets source for PSAs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct proactive media outreach, prepare supporting collateral, and place assets on the platforms and feeds journalists and programmers use to find PSAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution (technology & partners)
rubrics_metrics.description: Utilizing the latest distribution technologies and strategies with best in class partners across all media categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use up-to-date distribution tech and established partner relationships across TV, radio, outdoor, digital, and other media to maximize pick-up and delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Knowing what kind of support your campaign receives justifies the investment and where your message is being seen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure support and visibility (who ran the PSA, how often, and where) to demonstrate impact and inform future planning; use evaluation tools to track outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: PSA Digital (download site & formats)
rubrics_metrics.description: Our internal digital distribution download site where all PSAs in current distribution can be viewed and downloaded in several formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide centralized access to current PSA assets in multiple file formats so media outlets and partners can easily retrieve broadcast- and platform-ready files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative Services (master file production)
rubrics_metrics.description: We collaborate with clients and their external agencies to create TV, radio and outdoor master files ready for distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce broadcast- and outdoor-ready master files (TV, radio, outdoor) in required technical specifications to ensure immediate use by media outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance metrics (leads and conversions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measured campaign outcomes such as leads generated and actual conversions (example: 'we generated 782,000 leads, and 18,028 Volunteers actually joined').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track quantitative outcomes (e.g., leads, sign-ups, enrollments) as primary indicators of a PSA campaign's effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowering costs through improved distribution and strategy (testimonial: 'they did an incredible job in terms of lowering our costs').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate campaigns on cost metrics (cost per lead/conversion, total spend vs. results) and seek distribution strategies that reduce expenses while maintaining impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airtime and placement effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Re-positioning PSAs to get more airtime and securing better placements for increased exposure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess success by increases in airtime and improved placement; strategic repositioning can drive greater reach and frequency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration with paid advertising
rubrics_metrics.description: Experience in paid advertising helps integrate the PSA program into the overall advertising program and attain campaign goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate PSA distribution with paid media efforts where appropriate to amplify impact and align messaging across earned and paid channels.
